e.title: **一个**嵌入式保险**的 PHP SDK：**六万九千次下载、**MIT、**六个 CI 工作流、**而**最后的稳定版停在 **2023 年 11 月****：Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`——**⭐ 报价示例逐字用**「**event_ticket_protection**」**（**演唱会门票保障**）**；**⭐ 变更日志逐字写出**「**switched utf8_encode to use mbstring instead**」**；**⭐ 而 README 里有一节** `TODO` **逐条列出**三件尚未做的事**（**异步调用、**熔断中间件、**自带 HTTP 客户端**）**；**⚠️ 而**它**依赖的 **PHP 版本下限**与**自己的**代码风格脚本里写的版本范围**并不一致****
e.title_en: A PHP SDK for embedded insurance with nearly seventy thousand downloads, an MIT licence, six continuous-integration workflows, and a last stable release in November 2023: its quote example insures an event ticket, its changelog states that an encoding call was switched to a multibyte-string extension, and its readme keeps a to-do section listing three features that do not exist yet.
e.title_hk: **一個**嵌入式保險**的 PHP SDK：**六萬九千次下載、**MIT、**六個 CI 工作流、**而**最後的穩定版停在 2023 年 11 月****：Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`——**⭐ 報價示例逐字用**「**event_ticket_protection**」**；**⭐ 變更日誌逐字寫出**「**switched utf8_encode to use mbstring instead**」**；**⭐ 而 README 裡有一節** `TODO` **逐條列出**三件尚未做的事**；**⚠️ 而**它**依賴的 PHP 版本下限**與**自己代碼風格腳本裡寫的版本範圍**並不一致****
e.summary: **XCover SDK for PHP**（Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`）**是一家嵌入式保险服务商的**官方 PHP 客户端****——**逐字自述为**「**XCover API SDK for PHP**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 MIT**、**Packagist 累计下载 **69,385 次****、**共 **11 个版本**（**最新稳定版 **v2.1.0**，**2023-11-15**）**、**依赖逐字为** `php ^7.4.0||^8.0`、**`guzzlehttp/guzzle ^7.2`**、**`ext-json`、**`ext-mbstring`****；**仓库存于 **`CoverGenius/xcover-php`**（**MIT、**7 星、**65 个文件、**README **7,580 字节****）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **报价示例逐字**用** `policy_type` **`event_ticket_protection`****——**⭐ 即**它承保的是**一张演唱会门票**（**示例里事件名逐字为一位歌手、**场馆逐字为 **The O2**、**货币 **GBP、**国家 **GB**）**；**② **变更日志按**「**变更／**新增／**移除**」**三栏逐条写**，**并写明 **PHP 支持范围的**每一次收缩与扩张**；**③ **README 有一节** `TODO`**，**逐条列出**三件**尚未做**的事**（**⭐ 这一节**本词条认为**最值得抄**）**；**④ **六个 CI 工作流**（**含**静态分析与**安全扫描**）**，**而 **PHPStan 基线文件逐字为 **0 字节****（**⭐ 即**没有**需要抑制的告警**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未调用**。
e.summary_hk: **XCover SDK for PHP**（Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`）**是一家嵌入式保險服務商的**官方 PHP 客戶端****——**逐字自述為**「**XCover API SDK for PHP**」**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**Packagist 累計下載 69,385 次****、**共 11 個版本**（**最新穩定版 v2.1.0，**2023-11-15**）**、**依賴逐字為** `php ^7.4.0||^8.0`、**`guzzlehttp/guzzle ^7.2`**、**`ext-json`、**`ext-mbstring`****；**倉庫存於 `CoverGenius/xcover-php`**（**MIT、**7 星、**65 個檔案、**README 7,580 位元組****）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **報價示例逐字用 `policy_type` `event_ticket_protection`****——**⭐ 即**它承保的是**一張演唱會門票**（**示例裡場館逐字為 The O2、**貨幣 GBP、**國家 GB**）**；**② **變更日誌按**變更／**新增／**移除三欄逐條寫**，**並寫明 PHP 支持範圍的每一次收縮與擴張**；**③ **README 有一節 `TODO`**，**逐條列出三件尚未做的事**（**⭐ 最值得抄的一節**）**；**④ **六個 CI 工作流**（**含靜態分析與安全掃描**）**，**而 PHPStan 基線檔案逐字為 0 位元組****。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未調用**。
e.summary_en: This Packagist package **is the official PHP client for an embedded insurance provider**, described verbatim as an API SDK for PHP. **Measured this round**: an MIT licence, nearly seventy thousand downloads, eleven versions with the latest stable released in November 2023, and dependencies of PHP 7.4 or 8.0 and above, a Guzzle HTTP client at version 7.2 and above, and the JSON and multibyte-string extensions. **The repository behind it carries the same licence, seven stars, sixty-five files and a readme of about seven and a half kilobytes.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: the quote example insures an event ticket protection policy, naming a concert venue, a pound sterling currency and a United Kingdom customer; the changelog is written in added, changed and removed columns and records every expansion and contraction of the supported PHP range; the readme keeps a to-do section listing three features that do not exist yet, which is the part most worth copying; and there are six continuous-integration workflows including static analysis and a security scan, while the static analysis baseline file is zero bytes, meaning nothing needed suppressing.** **The package was not installed and not called this round.**
e.body:
**XCover SDK for PHP**（Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`）**是一家嵌入式保险服务商的**官方 PHP 客户端****——**逐字自述为**「**XCover API SDK for PHP**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Packagist 元数据、GitHub 仓库与包内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它承保的是什么，**示例里的答案是一张演唱会门票****——**README 的报价示例逐字把 `policy_type` 写成** `event_ticket_protection`**，**并把 `policy_type_version` 写成 **1****；**⭐ 示例里其余字段逐字含** `policy_start_date`、**`event_datetime`、**`event_name`（**逐字为一位歌手名**）、**`event_location`（**逐字为 **The O2**）**、**`number_of_tickets`（**2**）**、**`total_ticket_price`（**100**）**、**`resale_ticket`（**false**）**、**`event_country`（**GB**）**，**以及**整单的** `currency`（**GBP**）**、**`customer_country`（**GB**）**、**`customer_region`（**London**）**、**`customer_language`（**en**）****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**嵌入式保险**」**在代码里**长什么样**——**⭐ 它**不是**一张通用保单**，**而是**挂在**一个具体事件**（**一场演出）**上**、**按**票数**与**票面总价**计价**、**并**把**转售票标记**（**`resale_ticket`**）**当作**风险因子**之一****；**⭐ 并对 RIAA**：**这类**场景化定价**正是**「**保险嵌进别人的业务流程**」**的**最小可读样本**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 变更日志按三栏写，**并逐字记录**语言支持范围的**每次收放****——**本次实测** `CHANGELOG.md`**（**804 字节**）**逐字含**：**v2.1.0（**2023-11-15）**「**switched utf8_encode to use mbstring instead, requiring mbstring ext for php**」**与**「**switched guzzle json encode to stop using deprecated functionality**」**；**v2.0.1（**2023-07-21）**「**Add 8.2 support**」**、**「**Add SECURITY.md and security.txt in .well-known folder**」**、**「**Update PHP Requirements to 7.4 or 8.0 and up**」**、**「**Remove PHP VCR Test Listener for PHP 7 & 8 compatibility**」**；**2.0.0（**2022-02-16）**「**Support for PHP 8.0, 8.1**」**与**「**Support for PHP 7, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3**」（**列为 Removed**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得抄的是**格式**：**⭐ 每一条都写**「**改了什么行为**」**而**不只写**「**改了什么文件**」**，**而**语言版本支持**被当作**对外契约**来**声明其**扩张与**收缩**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ README 有一节 `TODO`，**把**尚未做的事**列出来****——**逐字为**「**There are a few features which we will add in the future releases**」**，**下列三条**：**「**Async calls using Guzzle promises**」**、**「**CircuitBreaker middleware**」**、**「**BYO HTTP Client**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这是本条目**最有教学价值的一处**——**⭐ 即**一个**六万九千次下载**的包**，**在**自己的 README 里**明说**三件**它**现在做不到**的事**；**⭐ 而**这三件**恰好**是**生产环境的常见诉求**（**并发、**失败隔离、**自带客户端**）**——**⭐ 故**读者**不会**因为**看不到**而产生**错误期待**。**⭐⭐ ④ 工程质量设施齐全，**而**基线是空的****——**本次实测**仓库 **65 个文件**，**其中**：**六个 GitHub 工作流**（**`changelog`／**`ci`／**`composer`／**`lint`／**`semgrep`／**`static`**）**、**`phpcs.xml`（**2,171 字节**）**、**`phpstan.neon`（**262 字节**）**、**`phpunit.xml`（**780 字节**）**、**`.well-known/security.txt`（**154 字节**）**、**`SECURITY.md`（**272 字节**）**、**`LICENSE`（**1,107 字节**）**；**⭐ 而**`phpstan-baseline.neon` **逐字为 **0 字节****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**基线为空**说明**静态分析**没有**需要**长期抑制的告警**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录这一事实**，**不主张**其**代码质量**）。**⭐ 源码侧**：`src/` 共 **8 个文件**，**其中 **`XCover.php` **12,970 字节**、**`AuthMiddleware.php` **2,992 字节**、**`Config.php` **2,346 字节**、**另有**两个异常类与**一个响应类**；**测试侧** `tests/`**：**`XCoverTest.php` **16,568 字节**（**⭐ 比它所测的**主类还大**）**，**另有**配置测试与**鉴权头中间件测试****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组数字**说明**它**把**测试与**静态分析**当成了**对外可见的承诺**（**README 逐字写明**：**测试、**风格检查与**静态分析**都在**每次推送与**每次拉取请求上跑**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 配置依赖里的一处**内部不一致****——**`composer.json` 的 **`require` 逐字要求** `php ^7.4.0||^8.0`**，**而**其 **`lint` 脚本逐字带参数** `--runtime-set testVersion 5.6-`**——**⭐ 即**代码风格检查**按 **PHP 5.6 起**的语法宽容度**在跑**，**而**声明支持的下限是 **7.4**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处**，**并**说明其影响**很小**（**⭐ 只影响**风格检查**的严格程度**）**——**⭐ 但**它**正好**是一个**可核查**的**小矛盾**，**⭐ 即**「**声明**」**与**「**工具参数**」**之间**也会**不一致**。**⭐ 另**`composer.json` 里**另有**一处**值得记**：**它**把**一个 PHPUnit 监听器**的**自建分支**写成了**自定义仓库**（**⭐ 说明**测试链路**有一段**不是**从公共源取得**的**）**，**并**设置了 **`minimum-stability` 为 `dev`＋**`prefer-stable`**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]] 覆盖**嵌入式保险 SDK**、**[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆盖**保险 API 集成**、**[[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 覆盖**场景化报价**、**[[clarity-sdk]] 覆盖**另一套行业 SDK**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**嵌入式保险的**官方 PHP SDK**：**下载在六万级**、**并**把「**还没做**」**写在自己的**说明里**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的三件事**：**① **把**尚未实现的功能**写进 README**（**⭐ 与其让使用者去猜**，**不如**列出三条**）**；**② **变更日志**要说**行为变化**，**并**把**语言或平台支持范围**当作**契约**来更新**；**③ **示例要**贴着真实场景写**（**⭐ 本条示例里**连**转售票**与**客户地区**都写了**）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该 SDK、**没有调用任何接口**（**未取任何报价、**未出任何保单**），**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**也不主张**其**与**真实服务的**对应关系**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库文件、**README、**变更日志与**元数据**，**未逐行读源码**（**⭐ 只按文件大小与文件名记录其结构**）**，**故**不主张**其**实现质量**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **API 文档**与**本 SDK** 是否**同步**（**⭐ 只知**README 里**指向**服务商的**接口文档页**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**接口条款**与 **MIT 代码许可**是否**相容**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**代码许可**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**主体信息变更**（**⭐ 只知**官网域名与**CDN 域名不同**，**本词条**不做**公司结构**方面的推测**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**包内**是否有**数据或**个人资料处理**相关的**说明**（**⭐ 示例里**含**客户国家与**地区字段**，**本词条**如实指出**这是一处**与**数据合规**相关的接口面**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**最新稳定版 **v2.1.0** 发布于 **2023-11-15**（**远在解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**嵌入式保险的**官方多语言 SDK**：**下载在六万级**、**README 里**明列**尚未实现的三件事**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该 SDK** 是**接口客户端**，**其**费率、**承保条件与**理赔责任**均**由**服务商与其**承保方**决定**。

**XCover SDK for PHP**（Packagist 包 `covergenius/xcover-php`）**是一家嵌入式保險服務商的**官方 PHP 客戶端****——**逐字自述為**「**XCover API SDK for PHP**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Packagist 元資料、GitHub 倉庫與包內檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它承保的是什麼，**示例的答案是一張演唱會門票****——**README 的報價示例逐字把 `policy_type` 寫成 `event_ticket_protection`**，**`policy_type_version` 為 1****；**⭐ 其餘欄位逐字含 `policy_start_date`、`event_datetime`、`event_name`（**逐字為一位歌手名**）、`event_location`（**逐字為 The O2**）、`number_of_tickets`（2）、`total_ticket_price`（100）、`resale_ticket`（false）、`event_country`（GB）**，**以及整單的 `currency`（GBP）、`customer_country`（GB）、`customer_region`（London）、`customer_language`（en）****。**⭐ 最值得記的一處**：**⭐ 即**「**嵌入式保險**」**在代碼裡長什麼樣**——**⭐ 它**不是一張通用保單**，**而是**掛在**一個具體事件**上**、**按票數與**票面總價計價**、**並**把**轉售票標記**當作**風險因子**之一**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 變更日誌按三欄寫**——**`CHANGELOG.md`（**804 位元組**）**逐字含**：**v2.1.0（**2023-11-15）**「**switched utf8_encode to use mbstring instead, requiring mbstring ext for php**」**與**「**switched guzzle json encode to stop using deprecated functionality**」**；**v2.0.1（**2023-07-21）**「**Add 8.2 support**」**、**「**Add SECURITY.md and security.txt in .well-known folder**」**、**「**Update PHP Requirements to 7.4 or 8.0 and up**」**；**2.0.0（**2022-02-16）**「**Support for PHP 8.0, 8.1**」**與**把 **PHP 7 系列列為 **Removed****。**⭐ 值得抄的是格式**：**每條都寫**「**改了什麼行為**」**；**語言版本支持**被當作**對外契約**來**聲明其擴張與收縮**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ README 有一節 `TODO`****——**逐字為**「**There are a few features which we will add in the future releases**」**，**下列三條**：**「**Async calls using Guzzle promises**」**、**「**CircuitBreaker middleware**」**、**「**BYO HTTP Client**」**。**⭐ 最有教學價值的一處**：**⭐ 即**一個**六萬九千次下載**的包**，**在 README 裡**明說**三件它**現在做不到**的事**——**⭐ 而這三件**恰好是**生產環境的常見訴求**（**並發、**失敗隔離、**自帶客戶端**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 工程設施齊全，**而**基線是空的****——**倉庫 65 個檔案**，**其中**：**六個 GitHub 工作流**（**changelog／**ci／**composer／**lint／**semgrep／**static**）**、**`phpcs.xml`（**2,171 位元組**）**、**`phpstan.neon`（**262 位元組**）**、**`phpunit.xml`（**780 位元組**）**、**`.well-known/security.txt`**、**`SECURITY.md`**、**`LICENSE`（**1,107 位元組**）**；**⭐ 而 `phpstan-baseline.neon` 逐字為 0 位元組****——**⭐ 即**基線為空**說明**靜態分析**沒有需要長期抑制的告警**。**⭐ 源碼側**：`src/` 共 8 個檔案，**其中 `XCover.php` 12,970 位元組**、**`AuthMiddleware.php` 2,992 位元組**、**`Config.php` 2,346 位元組**；**測試側**：`XCoverTest.php` **16,568 位元組**（**⭐ 比它所測的主類還大**）**。**⭐ 這一組數字說明**它**把測試與靜態分析**當成了**對外可見的承諾**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 配置依賴裡的一處內部不一致**——**`require` 逐字要求 `php ^7.4.0||^8.0`**，**而 `lint` 腳本逐字帶參數 `--runtime-set testVersion 5.6-`****——**⭐ 即**代碼風格檢查**按 PHP 5.6 起的寬容度在跑**，**而**聲明支持的下限是 7.4**；**⭐ 影響很小**（**只影響風格檢查的嚴格程度**）**，**但**它是一個**可核查的小矛盾**。**⭐ 另**`composer.json` 把一個 PHPUnit 監聽器的**自建分支**寫成**自定義倉庫**，**並**設置 `minimum-stability` 為 `dev` 加 `prefer-stable`**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[restaurant-insurance-quote]]、[[clarity-sdk]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**嵌入式保險的官方 PHP SDK：**下載在六萬級**、**並把「**還沒做**」**寫在自己的說明裡**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 三件事值得借**：**① **把尚未實現的功能**寫進 README**；**② **變更日誌要說行為變化**，**並**把語言或平台支持範圍**當契約更新**；**③ **示例要貼著真實場景寫**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該 SDK、**沒有調用任何介面**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**、**也不主張**其與真實服務的對應關係**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀倉庫檔案、**README、**變更日誌與**元資料**，**未逐行讀源碼**，**不主張**其實現質量**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其 API 文檔與本 SDK 是否同步**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其接口條款與 MIT 代碼許可是否相容**（**只記錄代碼許可**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其主體資訊變更**（**只知官網域名與 CDN 域名不同**，**不做公司結構方面的推測**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**包內是否有數據或個人資料處理相關說明**（**示例含客戶國家與地區欄位**，**如實指出這是一處與數據合規相關的介面面**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**最新穩定版 v2.1.0 發布於 2023-11-15（**遠在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**嵌入式保險的官方多語言 SDK：**下載在六萬級**、**README 裡明列尚未實現的三件事**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該 SDK 是介面客戶端**，**其費率、**承保條件與**理賠責任**均**由服務商與其承保方決定**。

This Packagist package **is the official PHP client for an embedded insurance provider**, described verbatim as an API SDK for PHP. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the public repository and the files inside it**: **first, the example answers what it insures, and the answer is a concert ticket.** The readme quote example sets the policy type to event ticket protection at version one, and the remaining fields name a policy start date, an event date and time, an event name, an event location, a ticket count, a total ticket price, a resale flag and an event country, alongside an order currency, a customer country, a customer region and a customer language. **That is the most useful thing here: it shows what embedded insurance looks like in code — not a general policy but one attached to a specific event, priced on ticket count and face value, with a resale flag treated as one of the risk factors.** **Second, the changelog is written in added, changed and removed columns and records every expansion and contraction of the supported language range**, starting with a change of encoding call to a multibyte-string extension and an update of JSON encoding away from deprecated functionality, then added support for a newer language version together with a security policy and a security contact file, and finally a major version that added support for two language versions while removing support for four older ones. **What is worth copying is the format: every entry states what behaviour changed rather than which file changed, and the supported language range is treated as an external contract whose widening and narrowing are declared.** **Third, the readme keeps a to-do section that lists what does not exist yet** — asynchronous calls using the HTTP client promises, a circuit breaker middleware, and support for a customer-supplied HTTP client. **This is the most valuable teaching point in the entry: a package with nearly seventy thousand downloads states in its own readme three things it cannot currently do, and those three are exactly the common production demands of concurrency, failure isolation and client substitution, so readers are not left with false expectations.** **Fourth, the engineering scaffolding is complete while its baseline is empty**: sixty-five files including six continuous-integration workflows for changelog, tests, dependency validation, linting, a security scanner and static analysis, alongside configuration for the linter, the static analyser and the test runner, a security contact file, a security policy and a licence file — **and the static analysis baseline is zero bytes, meaning no warnings needed long-term suppression, a fact this entry records without asserting anything about code quality**. On the source side there are eight files, the largest being the client class at about thirteen kilobytes, with an authentication middleware and a configuration class; on the test side the main test file is about sixteen and a half kilobytes, **larger than the class it tests**, which together indicate that tests and static analysis are treated as visible commitments, the readme stating verbatim that tests, style checks and static analysis run on every push and every pull request. **Fifth, one small internal inconsistency is worth recording**: the dependency declaration requires a minimum language version while the lint script passes a compatibility parameter starting three minor versions earlier, **so the style checker runs at a more permissive syntax level than the declared support floor — a minor effect on strictness only, but a checkable mismatch between a declaration and a tool parameter**. The same configuration file also pins a custom repository for a forked test listener, meaning part of the test chain is not fetched from a public source, and sets minimum stability to development while preferring stable releases. **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an embedded pet insurance SDK, an insurance API bundle, scenario-based quoting and another industry SDK, **while this entry supplies the official PHP SDK of an embedded insurance provider, downloaded nearly seventy thousand times, which writes down what it has not built yet. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **three practices transfer: write the unimplemented features into the readme instead of letting users guess; make the changelog describe behaviour and treat platform support ranges as a contract; and write examples that sit close to a real scenario, as this one does by including a resale flag and a customer region.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the SDK was not installed and no interface was called**, so no quote was requested and no policy was issued, **and no claim is made that any feature works or that it corresponds to a live service**. **Second, only repository files, the readme, the changelog and metadata were read, and no source code was read line by line**, structure being recorded only from file names and sizes, **so nothing is asserted about implementation quality**. **Third, whether the provider API documentation and this SDK are in step was not verified.** **Fourth, whether the provider interface terms are compatible with the MIT code licence was not verified**, only the code licence being recorded. **Fifth, no corporate change was verified beyond observing that the website domain and a content delivery domain differ, and this entry does not speculate about company structure.** **Sixth, whether the package says anything about data or personal information handling was not verified**, and **this entry notes plainly that the example carries customer country and region fields, which is an interface surface with data compliance implications**. **Seventh, on the window: the latest stable release dates from November 2023, far outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is an official multi-language SDK for embedded insurance with downloads in the tens of thousands that lists three unimplemented features in its own readme. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the SDK is an interface client whose rates, underwriting terms and claim liabilities are decided by the provider and its underwriters.**
